as_of: 2026-09-20, of3t-orchestrator pass 192 -- a guard PROPOSED, PROTOTYPED and REJECTED, plus the real defect it found on the way
why_a_guard_was_attempted: three times now the campaign's headline has asserted something its own body had already retired: SS7 'has NEVER BEEN RUN' two passes after it ran; the diffusion transformer called revision-inert when it is not; and this pass, 'the mechanism is an operator MULTIPLYING the arriving cotangent' sitting in the_answer while THE_TRUNK_SCOPE_IS_SETTLED_NO_GO_pass_186 in the SAME FILE said there is no amplifier. A 3x recurrence is the campaign's threshold for a guard rather than another fix.
the_guard_I_tried: a retirement registry: once a claim is retired, no LIVE field of any orchestrator artifact may still assert it. Skip fields whose key marks them dead (RETIRED|SUPERSEDED|REFUTED|WITHDRAWN|CORRECTED|_pass_N), phrase-match the rest.

why_it_was_REJECTED.run_against_the_real_corpus: 7 live fields matched. FIVE were legitimate -- artifacts DISCUSSING the retired characterisation, including one whose own filename is THE_240_IS_A_COUNT_THE_FUSED_QKV_IS_A_CHARACTERISATION.json and two recording the lesson in a later artifact.
why_it_was_REJECTED.the_narrow_form_is_vacuous: restricting to headline fields only (headline/the_answer/verdict/what) drops to ONE hit, and that one is also a false positive -- the retraction artifact's own headline. So the narrow form catches nothing real and the wide form is mostly noise.
why_it_was_REJECTED.the_structural_reason: the text that RETIRES a claim must quote the claim. Any phrase-matcher therefore fires hardest on exactly the artifacts doing the right thing, and a filename skip does not save it because the lesson also gets recorded in later, differently-named files. This would have been the sixth over-wide guard in this campaign, and the campaign's own rule is that a guard which fires on correct work is worse than none.

and_the_prototype_found_a_REAL_one_befor: THE_ANSWER.json's `by_scope` table still read "the remaining ~1.266 % is the trunk's 240 unplaced FUSED-QKV leaves and small embedders". I had corrected that characterisation in `what_would_close_it.the_2_pct` at pass 183 and never propagated it to the table. Now corrected to the measured form: 603 upstream leaves unplaced across six sections (pairformer_stack 240, diffusion_module 190, input_embedder 93, msa_module 32, template_embedder 28, aux_heads 20), with the 'fused-qkv' label explicitly withdrawn in place. by_scope still sums to 100.0.
what_replaces_the_guard: a SWEEP, run by hand at the moment a claim is retired rather than continuously: grep every artifact for the retired phrase, read each hit, and correct the ones that ASSERT it while leaving the ones that RETIRE it. That is what was done here and it is what found the by_scope miss. It is not automatable for the structural reason above, so it is recorded as a practice and not pretended into a check.
honest_cost: a practice is weaker than a guard -- it depends on remembering to run it. The mitigation is that the sweep is cheap (one grep, a few reads) and that the three recurrences all shared one trigger: retiring a claim. Tie the sweep to that moment and it is hard to skip.
provenance: of3t-orchestrator pass 192 on pc, CPU only. Prototype run over perf/of3t_orchestrator/*.json in this branch; no measurement.
a29_exempt: this artifact ASSERTS no inertness. It quotes 'revision-inert' only to recount a claim the campaign already retired (D108), as one of the three recurrences that motivated the guard attempt described here. A29 requires a source path from anything CLAIMING inertness; demanding one from the text that retires such a claim is the exact over-firing this file documents, so the exemption is declared rather than dodged by adding a path that would prove nothing.
